tools.name: setup_trade
tools.description: Create a business, or update its saved settings (call with trade_key to update). Saves the rates and rules every quote uses: day and hour rates, labourer rate, materials markup, VAT registration and number, CIS, deposit rule, validity, payment terms, standard exclusions, brand colour, logo (https li

tools.name: get_trade
tools.description: The trade's saved settings, price book (most used first), quote stats (win rate, value won in the last 12 months) and, for a business that is not VAT registered, a warning when accepted work is nearing the £90,000 VAT registration threshold.

tools.name: save_price_items
tools.description: Add or update materials in the trade's price book, so later quotes can use { code, qty } and the cost, unit and markup fill in. Materials used in quotes are also remembered automatically.

tools.name: draft_quote
tools.description: Price a job after a site visit. Give the job, customer, labour (time, priced from the saved rate), materials (trade cost, marked up), other costs and optional extras; the server applies VAT correctly (registered or not, 20/5/0%, the construction domestic reverse charge for contractor customers), the

tools.name: revise_quote
tools.description: Change a quote. Send only the fields that change (a list you send, such as materials, replaces that whole list). A draft stays a draft. A quote the customer already has becomes the next revision on the same link, with fresh dates, and any earlier answer is cleared. Accepted quotes cannot change. sta

tools.name: finalise_quote
tools.description: Lock a draft so the customer can answer it. Sets today's date and the valid-until date, and returns the customer link, the PDF link and a short ready-to-send message. Nothing is sent by this server: the trade sends the link by their own text, WhatsApp or email. Free allowance: 5 finalised quotes per

tools.name: quote_activity
tools.description: What customers have done since the trade last checked: quotes opened, accepted (with the name they signed, extras ticked and final total), questions asked, declined. Marks them as seen unless mark_seen is false. Answers when the trade asks "any news on my quotes?".

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: One quote in full: lines, totals, VAT working with HMRC sources, margins (trade only), the customer's answer, history (drafted, sent, opened, accepted) and links.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: Recent quotes, newest first, with status (draft, sent, viewed, queried, accepted, declined, expired, withdrawn), total and whether there is news. Filter by status or search customer name, job title or number.

tools.name: reply_to_customer
tools.description: Answer a customer's question. The answer shows on their quote page under their question. Price or scope changes are made with revise_quote, not here.

tools.name: export_to_nero_work
tools.description: The quote in the exact argument shape of the Nero Work exchange's submit_quote tool (labour_minor, materials_minor, vat_minor in pence, validity_hours, exclusions, notes), checked with Nero Work's own rules. If the customer accepted with extras, they are included.
